t: This is Trinity Laban Conservatoire of Music and Dance, in South East London. It was formed in 2005 by merging Trinity College of Music with the Laban Dance Centre. The Laban in the name is Rudolf Laban, the Austrian choreographer and movement theorist, often called a founding father of expressionist dance. He developed Labanotation, a way of recording movement. Today about twelve hundred and fifty students train here in classical music, jazz, musical theatre, contemporary dance and more, across campuses in Greenwich, Deptford and New Cross.
